name: save-actions
description: Tidies a file every time you save it: trims trailing whitespace and fixes the final newline.

commands.title: Save Actions: Tidy the Current File Now

settings.title: Trim trailing whitespace
settings.description: Remove spaces and tabs at the end of every line.

settings.title: Keep trailing spaces in Markdown
settings.description: Two spaces at the end of a Markdown line mean a line break, so they are left alone.

settings.title: Insert final newline
settings.description: End the file with exactly one line break.

settings.title: Remove extra blank lines at the end
settings.description: Collapse several empty lines at the end of the file into one line break.
